quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Having spent the better part of a decade renting apartments that never quite felt like home, Farrah finally signed the paperwork on a small two-bedroom condo last month, and unpacking the last box felt more satisfying than she expected.
quests.hint: Find what Farrah finally signed the paperwork on.
quests.explanation: The passage says she signed for a condo, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Interestingly, because so many working adults had expressed interest in a flexible schedule, the vocational program introduced a hybrid format combining online lectures with occasional weekend labs, attracting a noticeably older group of applicants.
quests.hint: Find what format the vocational program introduced.
quests.explanation: The passage says a hybrid format, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because the previous onboarding process left too many new hires feeling overwhelmed within their first week, the human resources team redesigned it around a slower, mentor-guided introduction spread across the entire first month.
quests.hint: Find what process was redesigned by human resources.
quests.explanation: The passage says the onboarding process, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Having exhausted the usual tourist attractions during her first visit, Bianca returned to the same city two years later determined to explore neighborhoods that rarely appear in any guidebook.
quests.hint: Find what Bianca was determined to explore on her second visit.
quests.explanation: The passage says neighborhoods rarely in guidebooks, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Tellingly, having grown up as an only child, Marcus initially struggled to understand the constant negotiation required when his three stepchildren moved in after his remarriage, though he now embraces the chaos of family dinners.
quests.hint: Find who moved in after Marcus remarried.
quests.explanation: The passage says his three stepchildren, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Having been burned once by a mattress that seemed comfortable in the showroom but felt entirely different after a week at home, Owen now insists on ordering only from companies offering a genuine trial period.
quests.hint: Find what type of period Owen now insists on.
quests.explanation: The passage says a genuine trial period, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Having watched her grandmother prepare the same regional stew every winter for as long as she can remember, Marisol finally wrote down the recipe from memory this year, since it had never been recorded on paper.
quests.hint: Find what dish her grandmother prepared every winter.
quests.explanation: The passage says a regional stew, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Strikingly, having relied on a single external hard drive for years without any backup system, Tomas learned the hard way after a sudden failure wiped out nearly a decade of family photos.
quests.hint: Find what wiped out nearly a decade of photos.
quests.explanation: The passage says a sudden failure, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Having dismissed her persistent lower back pain as simply a consequence of long hours at a desk, Wren finally consulted a physical therapist who identified poor posture, rather than age, as the actual underlying cause.
quests.hint: Find what the therapist identified as the actual cause.
quests.explanation: The passage says poor posture, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Having built a loyal following through years of small, intimate shows in local bars, the singer-songwriter was visibly overwhelmed when her first arena performance sold out within minutes.
quests.hint: Find what type of performance sold out within minutes.
quests.explanation: The passage says her arena performance, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Curiously, having tracked the same pod of dolphins along the coastline for nearly fifteen years, marine biologists have begun to notice subtle shifts in feeding patterns linked to warming coastal waters.
quests.hint: Find what animal biologists have tracked for fifteen years.
quests.explanation: The passage says a pod of dolphins, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Having watched the downtown business district slowly decline over nearly two decades, a coalition of longtime residents pooled their own savings to renovate the abandoned theater themselves.
quests.hint: Find who pooled their own savings to renovate the theater.
quests.explanation: The passage says a coalition of residents, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Ever since a minor car accident left him without transportation for nearly three weeks, Idris has relied almost entirely on his bicycle for errands, and he has been surprised at the money he has saved.
quests.hint: Find what Idris now relies on for errands.
quests.explanation: The passage says his bicycle, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Remarkably, ever since the university introduced a mandatory orientation week for international students, reports of early homesickness and confusion about campus resources have dropped considerably, according to a recent survey.
quests.hint: Find what week the university introduced for international students.
quests.explanation: The passage says a mandatory orientation week, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Ever since noticing that most internal complaints traced back to unclear expectations rather than actual performance problems, Renata's manager began scheduling brief weekly check-ins to clarify priorities early.
quests.hint: Find what the manager began scheduling weekly.
quests.explanation: The passage says weekly check-ins, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Ever since budget airlines began offering direct routes to the smaller regional airport, travel time to the coastal towns has been cut nearly in half compared to flying through the larger, congested hub.
quests.hint: Find what type of airport now has direct routes.
quests.explanation: The passage says the smaller regional airport, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Crucially, ever since her father's memory began noticeably declining, Elena has taken on the role of managing his medical appointments, a responsibility she balances alongside her own demanding full-time job.
quests.hint: Find what began noticeably declining in Elena's father.
quests.explanation: The passage says his memory declined, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Ever since a data breach exposed customer payment details at a major retailer, more shoppers say they now prefer using a single-use virtual card number for any unfamiliar online store.
quests.hint: Find what type of card number shoppers now prefer.
quests.explanation: The passage says a virtual card number, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Ever since discovering that a local mill sold flour milled the same week it was ordered, the neighborhood bakery has refused to switch back to the mass-produced alternative it used for years.
quests.hint: Find what local business sells freshly milled flour.
quests.explanation: The passage says a local mill, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Importantly, ever since her smart thermostat began learning her daily schedule, Priti has noticed a modest but consistent drop in her monthly energy bill compared to the manual system she used previously.
quests.hint: Find what device began learning Priti's daily schedule.
quests.explanation: The passage says her smart thermostat, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Ever since the clinic began offering same-day appointments for urgent but non-emergency concerns, emergency room visits for minor issues in the surrounding area have dropped noticeably.
quests.hint: Find what type of appointments the clinic began offering.
quests.explanation: The passage says same-day appointments, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Ever since the studio began releasing behind-the-scenes footage alongside each new episode, fan engagement across social media has increased substantially compared to previous seasons.
quests.hint: Find what the studio began releasing alongside each episode.
quests.explanation: The passage says behind-the-scenes footage, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Incidentally, ever since a controlled reintroduction of wolves began nearly two decades ago, the surrounding forest ecosystem has shown measurable improvements in both plant diversity and stream health.
quests.hint: Find what animal was reintroduced nearly two decades ago.
quests.explanation: The passage says wolves were reintroduced, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Ever since the neighborhood association introduced a shared tool library, residents have reported spending considerably less on equipment they previously used only once or twice a year.
quests.hint: Find what type of library the association introduced.
quests.explanation: The passage says a shared tool library, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because her downstairs neighbor practices the trumpet most evenings, Priya invested in a decent pair of noise-canceling headphones purely so she could concentrate while reading after dinner.
quests.hint: Find what instrument the downstairs neighbor practices.
quests.explanation: The passage says the trumpet, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Admittedly, since the university introduced a mandatory orientation week, reports of early homesickness among first-year students have dropped considerably, according to a survey conducted by the student affairs office.
quests.hint: Find what has dropped considerably among first-year students.
quests.explanation: The passage says reports of homesickness dropped, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Since the warehouse switched to a rotating shift model instead of fixed schedules, employees report having far more flexibility to attend appointments without formally requesting time off.
quests.hint: Find what type of shift model the warehouse switched to.
quests.explanation: The passage says a rotating shift model, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because the mountain refuge accepts no reservations and operates strictly on a first-come basis, experienced hikers recommend arriving well before sunset during the busy summer season.
quests.hint: Find what accepts no reservations and operates first-come.
quests.explanation: The passage says the mountain refuge, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Revealingly, because both of Farid's parents immigrated decades before he was born, family gatherings often become an opportunity for older relatives to share stories about a homeland he has never visited.
quests.hint: Find what older relatives share stories about.
quests.explanation: The passage says their homeland, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because the boutique sources every garment from a small number of named workshops, prices run noticeably higher than typical fast-fashion retailers, though loyal customers say the quality justifies the difference.
quests.hint: Find what type of shop sources from named workshops.
quests.explanation: The passage says the boutique, so that is correct.
